memo: Base: Ahmed Berat Ozer 'casmi26-v15-n1a' v1 (its v14 = public LB 0.455: E006 lineage + PubChemLite CC0 candidates in engine 2; v15 adds seyitkaangunes' N1A GLACIER proxies), kernels/e3/base_v15.ipynb, unchanged except the cells marked ours. This version: port of ahmedberatozer casmi26-v19-bioext's BX block (not ours: PubChem structures from biological depositors into engine 2's pool, output of ahmedberatozer/casmi26-bioext-build; its LB is not published) + our two pool parts (own COCONUT, own PubChem tier >= 5 PubMed links) + ours_lfrag. Hypothesis: the public lineage's next pool step plus ours lifts us toward silver/gold, LB > 0.456. CPU kernel (the GPU week of 30 h ran out at the push of e3v15bxo-1): ICEBERG / GLACIER on the CPU, the base's ICEBERG budget (5,400 s) kept so the larger pool still fits in 9 h; the CPU versions of earlier bases scored about 0.006 under their GPU runs, so the comparison is with the CPU line. build.py v15bxoc base=v15 bx=1 ownco=1 ownpc=5 lfrag=1 cpu.
